Netflix renews Tyler Perry's Beauty in Black for Season 4

The popular drama series has been renewed for a fourth season, reversing an earlier decision to end the show. The second season achieved massive global success, spending six weeks on Netflix's Global Top 10 list and reaching number one in 17 countries.

Hot take: Season 2 was the peak and nothing after will top it — agree or come for me?
